QuestInfo.2: #b#p19#'s#k question was about equippable items, which can be worn by double-clicking on them.

0.0: All right, talk to me when you're ready for the next question.

1.0:
Can you wear an item just by double-clicking it with your mouse? 

#L0# #bOh yes#l
#L1# No way.#k#l
1.1: Yup, you can wear an item just by double-clicking it from your inventory. If you can't wear something, check that your character meets the level and statistic requirements.

0.1: Try it! Open your Equipment Inventory, then take off an item by double-clicking it. After that, double-click the item in your Inventory to put it back on.
